en: The image shows an old church with a prominent mural along the upper exterior wall featuring a long procession of human and skeletal figures, which is a typical 'Danse Macabre' (Dance of Death) motif. There are gravestones and crosses in the foreground, indicating a cemetery. The roof is made of reddish tiles, and the stonework is visible. The text on the postcard is in Italian and mentions 'Chiesa S. Vigilio col Ballo della Morte' and 'Pinzolo.'
